item.name: Combat
item.cardSummary: The default Common melee style every account starts with. No seller, materials, race, or mastery route is listed.

item.name: Verdant Hero
item.cardSummary: The first buyable melee style. Purchase it from Deku at Legend's Arena after farming One for all's Cell. No official mastery card is listed.

item.name: Gojo
item.materials: x2 Six Eye, x8 Infinity Essence, x15 Cursed Shard
item.masteryQuests: Deal 200M damage with Gojo. Defeat 45 any bosses. Defeat Gojo 20 times. Unlocks R.
item.moveKeys: M1, Z, X, C, V, mastery R
item.cardSummary: A Legendary Jujutsu Highschool style bought from the Gojo NPC with Six Eye, Infinity Essence, and Cursed Shards. Mastery unlocks the R key.

item.name: Sukuna
item.materials: x15 Cursed Shard, x20 Sukuna's Finger
item.masteryQuests: Deal 200M damage with Sukuna. Kill 450 any NPCs. Defeat Sukuna 20 times. Unlocks R.
item.moveKeys: M1, Z, X, C, V, mastery R
item.cardSummary: The other Legendary Jujutsu Highschool style, bought from the Sukuna NPC with Cursed Shards and Sukuna's Fingers. Mastery unlocks the R key.

item.name: Rimuru
item.materials: x7 Slime Core, x1 Shizu Mask, x10 Slime Essence
item.masteryQuests: Obtain the Demon Lord title. Kill 3,000 NPCs. Unlocks R.
item.moveKeys: M1, Z, X, C, V, mastery R
item.cardSummary: A Mythical Fossil Island style that requires Slime Race plus Rimuru boss materials. Mastery asks for the Demon Lord title and a large NPC kill count.

item.name: Aizen
item.materials: x1 Hogyoku, x5 Shattered Soul, x10 Formless Mirror, x30 Reishi Core, x35 Void Silk
item.masteryQuests: Deal 1B damage with Aizen. Kill 15 players. Defeat Aizen 15 times. Equip The Betrayer title. Unlocks F and R. F adds +35% Aizen damage.
item.moveKeys: M1, Z, X, C, V, mastery F, mastery R
item.cardSummary: A Mythical Hueco Mundo style gated behind True Shinigami Race and Aizen materials. Mastery unlocks F, which boosts Aizen damage, plus R.

item.name: Gilgamesh
item.materials: x1 Genesis core, x4 Babylon Fragment, x7 Tyrant's Crest, x20 Golden Essence
item.masteryQuests: Deal 850M damage with Gilgamesh while using Demi God Race. Then defeat Shank 50, Mihawk 50, Ichigo (Bankai) 35, Saber 25, Sung Jinwoo 2, Rimuru 1, Aizen 2, and Gilgamesh Hard/Extreme 10. Unlocks R.
item.moveKeys: M1, Z, X, C, V, mastery R
item.cardSummary: A Mythical Legend's Arena style that needs the King of Heroes title and Gilgamesh materials. Mastery is a long boss list plus Demi God Race.

item.name: Gojo (Shinjuku)
item.materials: x1 True six eye, x1 Infinty Core, x5 Limitless Shard, x100 Cursed Shard
item.masteryNpc: Limitless Scroll Seller at Shinjuku Showdown
item.masteryQuests: Deal 1.5B damage with Gojo Shinjuku. Defeat Gojo 30 times. Use any Gojo Shinjuku skill 250 times. Defeat Gojo Shinjuku 20 times. Exchange x50 Cursed Shard, x2 Infinty Core, and x5 Limitless Shard for 1 Limitless Scroll. Unlocks V and R.
item.moveKeys: M1, Z, X, C, F (+15% Gojo Shinjuku damage), mastery V, mastery R
item.cardSummary: The Mythical Shinjuku Gojo style. Buy it with Enlightened Race and Shinjuku Gojo drops, then finish the Limitless Scroll quests for V and R.

item.name: Sukuna (Shinjuku)
item.materials: x1 Slash Core, x5 True Sukuna Fingers, x5 Shrine Shard, x100 Cursed Shard
item.masteryNpc: Shrine Scroll Seller at Shinjuku Showdown
item.masteryQuests: Deal 1.5B damage with Sukuna Shinjuku. Defeat Sukuna 30 times. Use any Sukuna Shinjuku skill 250 times. Defeat Sukuna Shinjuku 20 times. Exchange x50 Cursed Shard, x2 Slash Core, and x5 Shrine Shard for 1 Shrine Scroll. Unlocks V and R.
item.moveKeys: M1, Z, X, C, F (+15% Sukuna Shinjuku damage), mastery V, mastery R
item.cardSummary: The Mythical Shinjuku Sukuna style. Vessel Race and Shinjuku Sukuna drops unlock the seller, and the Shrine Scroll quests unlock V and R.

item.name: Yhwach
item.materials: x3 Eye of the Almighty, x5 Angel Halo, x5 Bomb Core, x5 Miracle Core, x5 Poison Vial, x5 Silver Shield, x10 Quincy Cross, x400 Blue Soul
item.masteryQuests: Deal 5B damage with Yhwach. Equip The Quincy King title. Dodge with Observation Haki 200 times. Defeat Ichigo (Bankai) 50 times. Defeat Aizen 25 times. Defeat Yhwach Hard/Extreme 20 times. Unlocks F and R.
item.moveKeys: M1, Z, X, C, V, mastery F, mastery R
item.cardSummary: A Mythical Hueco Mundo style gated behind Quincy Race and Wandenreich materials. Mastery is a long Hueco Mundo questline that unlocks F and R.

item.name: Firefly
item.materials: x1 Molten Core, x3 Shaper, x6 Firefly's Will, x9 Ignition Valve, x250 Armor Scrap
item.masteryQuests: Deal 2B damage with Firefly. Equip The Molten Knight title. Use any Firefly skill 300 times. Clear Simulated Sea (Sea 5) once. Defeat Fyrefly Type-IV 15 times.
item.moveKeys: Stage 1: M1, F. Stage 2: M1, Z, X, F. Stage 3: M1, Z, X, C, V, R
item.cardSummary: A Mythical Monument Isle melee style, not a sword. Glamoth Race and Glamoth materials buy it, and the Shaper NPC handles mastery for the staged kit.
